community_list_entries.name: PersonaBench
PersonaBench: Evaluating AI Models on Understanding Personal Information through Accessing (Synthetic) Private User Data

phase1_classification.kind_reason: PersonaBench (arXiv 2502.20616) is built on synthetic users' private documents (conversation history, user-AI interactions, app usage). It evaluates whether models, mainly RAG pipelines, can extract personal facts, preferences and social connections from that user data.
